rounding_tolerance: Half the unit in the last printed decimal place. Integers in printed approximate ESS use 0.5 tolerance.

II-table-01.not_verified: Particle-ID disjointness and full partition arrays require original catalogs and/or saved index arrays. Percentages are design proportions, not exact realized counts.

II-table-03.not_verified: Low-capacity 3/131/514 closure tables for Mock-2/3, and the 3/131 tests in Mock-1, are not included in this review bundle. High-mode closure is a distinct experiment and was not substituted.

notes: Two Paper I Table II entries differ by one unit in the last printed digit under direct rounding. No manuscript was changed.
The same two values occur in both independent saved aggregate paths (convergence and final sensitivity). Double rounding is a possible explanation, not established provenance.
Confidence-interval endpoints were compared with saved bootstrap summaries; bootstrap sampling itself was not rerun.
Table II (II) is checked against the original catalog-description TXT, not re-counted from a binary catalog.
